bhoomi.name: Bhoomi Jain

bullets: Engineered 12+ responsive, cross-platform web interface modules for a Metaverse-themed product using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and Figma-driven design systems, lifting average user interaction time by 35% in 8 weeks.

Constructed reusable component layouts in close collaboration with creative and product partners, accelerating brand engagement by 20% through structured A/B testing validated via Google Analytics and Hotjar heatmaps.
Profiled and refactored render performance across iterations, reducing layout shift and improving Lighthouse mobile scores by 18 points across 3 high-traffic breakpoints.
Authored a data-informed content strategy integrating analytics dashboards and audience segmentation, amplifying engagement by 30% and reach by 20% across owned channels in 12 weeks.
Produced 25+ web-ready multimedia assets—blog landing visuals, banners, and ad creatives—using Figma, Canva, and Adobe Spark, generating a 15% uplift in click-through rate.
Spearheaded multi-channel campaigns across Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn, increasing audience engagement by 20% across 3 platforms through funnel-tested creatives and iterative copy variants.
Automated 4 reporting dashboards in Google Data Studio with Excel macros, eliminating 3 hrs/week of manual effort and improving campaign tracking efficiency by 10%.

smartblog-ai.name: SmartBlog AI
smartblog-ai.subtitle: Full-Stack AI Blogging Platform
bullets: Crafted a responsive single-page web application in ReactJS with reusable functional components, React Router-based navigation, and Tailwind utility-first styling, delivering a mobile-first UI across 320px–1440px breakpoints.

Implemented secure authentication and protected routes with JWT, React Context, and bcrypt-hashed credentials, integrating frontend forms with a Node.js/Express REST API and Mongoose-backed MongoDB schemas.

Modularized the dashboard into composable UI primitives and instrumented client-side caching with React Query, cutting redundant network calls by ~45%; validated component logic with unit and integration tests.

conversational-ai-web-app.name: Conversational AI Web App
bullets: Devised a real-time chat interface in ReactJS with optimistic UI updates, controlled inputs, and custom hooks for streaming responses, supporting 500+ test sessions without UI regressions.
Integrated the React client with a FastAPI backend over REST and deployed to AWS EC2, slashing end-to-end latency by 40% through request batching, lazy loading, and asset compression.
